messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed p99 jump for hosted text-gen after we promoted runtime v2.14.3 -> v2.15.0 in canary at 03:00 UTC. p95 up ~120ms, p99 up ~450ms. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.dev/obs/runtime/p95

devon: saw that too — came in via CS-789. Customers seeing slow completions and occasional 503s. Any immediate revert plan? :thinking:

olivia: pulling traces now. Initial look shows two things: increased tail time on quantized kernels and a secondary auth token refresh latency spike. Could be correlated but separate causes.

maria: canary was 10% traffic to v2.15.0 — changes were quant-encoding tweak + kernel-selector update.

james: customer reported reproducible p99 when prompt length >1024 tokens, included logs.

devon: repro steps from customer: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/complete -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"rwd-4b-q8k","input":"<~1200 tokens>"}' with concurrency 4.

olivia: running a local mini-repro with same model + seq_len 1200, concurrency 4. Will attach flamegraphs.

support-bot: deploybot: rollout started 3129997000 -> v2.15.0 (canary 10%).

maria: quick mitigation options: 1) pause canary 2) rollback kernel-selector only 3) route >1024 token requests to v2.14.3 variant. I lean pause + route for affected customers.

devon: pausing canary now — setting ramp to 0% (in flight completes).

olivia: traces show KV-cache miss rate spikes on v2.15.0 for seq_len >1024. Kernel selector falls back to slow path that does extra memcpy+re-alloc. Snippet from local stack: 
```
runtime/kernel_selector.cpp:412
if (quant_mode == Q8 && seq_len > 1024) do_slow_kernel();
```
That conditional looks like a regression from the refactor.

maria: that looks like a smoking gun. Also seeing token service retries bump from 1.1 -> 3.2 per request on canary under load — could amplify tail.

james: customer logs showed token refresh 401 then success, retries added ~300ms per refresh which pushes some requests into the slow kernel window.

devon: preparing rollback job for canary variant. Will target full rollback of runtime to v2.14.3 for canary cohort.

support-bot: deploybot: rollback initiated 3130000500 -> v2.14.3 (canary).

olivia: monitoring metrics now. Initial numbers: p95 trending down toward baseline, p99 dropping quickly, KV-cache miss rate on recovered nodes falling.

support-bot: deploybot: rollback completed 3130001000 -> v2.14.3 (canary).

maria: post-rollback snapshot: p95 returned to baseline, p99 reduced by ~380ms vs canary peak. Auth retry rate also normalized.

devon: follow-ups: open PR to fix kernel_selector boundary handling (remove expensive fallback for Q8), add unit/regtest for seq_len edges, and add a safe default to route >1024 tokens to stable runtime until fixed.

james: I'll notify customer (CS-789) with timeline and remediation steps and offer extended credits; will confirm after 24h stable.

maria: I'll file a short postmortem and changelog entry. Also proposing we add a canary smoke test specifically for long-sequence workloads (synthetic >1024 tokens) to catch this earlier.

devon: adding playbook notes to #incidents: reproduce steps, trace collection commands, rollback commands, and routing override steps.

maria: thanks — great quick ops. We'll track follow-up PRs and set a blocker for runtime v2.15.x until kernel_selector fix merges. :thumbsup:
